_comment: Operator-VERIFIED names only. name_arabic MUST be pasted by the operator (an Arabic reader) from a trusted source — it is NEVER AI-generated. Set verified:true only after you have entered and checked the Arabic. Blank/unverified entries never render (generate.py skips them). The name_latin + meaning below are an English convenience roster to fill in; edit meanings freely.

ibrahim.meaning: The name Ibrahim, meaning “father of many nations,” belongs to one of the most revered prophets in Islam. Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) is mentioned 69 times across 25 chapters of the Quran, and the 14th Surah bears his name — a symbol of unwavering faith, devotion, and leadership.

muhammad.meaning: Muhammad means “the praised one” — the name of the final Prophet of Islam and the most given name in the world.

yusuf.meaning: Yusuf (Joseph) means “God shall increase” — a prophet renowned for his patience, beauty, and forgiveness.

ali.meaning: Ali means “exalted, noble, sublime” — a name of dignity and high standing.

omar.meaning: Omar means “flourishing, long-lived” — associated with strength and just leadership.

hamza.meaning: Hamza means “lion” and “steadfast” — a name of courage and strength.

zayd.meaning: Zayd means “growth, abundance, increase” — a name of blessing and progress.

bilal.meaning: Bilal means “moisture, freshness” — borne by the first muezzin of Islam, a symbol of devotion.

idris.meaning: Idris is the name of an early prophet, associated with knowledge and study.

ismail.meaning: Ismail (Ishmael) means “God will hear” — a prophet and son of Ibrahim.

musa.meaning: Musa (Moses) is one of the greatest prophets, who spoke with God.

isa.meaning: Isa (Jesus) is a revered prophet and messenger of God in Islam.

adam.meaning: Adam, the first human and prophet, means “of the earth.”

yahya.meaning: Yahya (John) means “he shall live” — a righteous prophet of purity.

dawud.meaning: Dawud (David) means “beloved” — a prophet and king known for his devotion and beautiful voice.

khalid.meaning: Khalid means “eternal, immortal” — a name of endurance and legacy.

hassan.meaning: Hassan means “handsome, good, benefactor” — a beloved grandson of the Prophet.

hussain.meaning: Hussain means “good, handsome” — a beloved grandson of the Prophet.

aisha.meaning: Aisha means “living, prosperous, full of life” — a name of vitality.

maryam.meaning: Maryam (Mary) is the honoured mother of Prophet Isa — a symbol of purity and faith.

fatima.meaning: Fatima means “one who abstains” — the beloved daughter of the Prophet Muhammad.

khadija.meaning: Khadija, the Prophet’s first wife, is honoured for her strength, loyalty, and generosity.

zainab.meaning: Zainab is the name of a fragrant flowering tree — a symbol of beauty and grace.

amina.meaning: Amina means “trustworthy, faithful, secure” — the name of the Prophet’s mother.

noor.meaning: Noor means “light” — divine radiance and guidance.

layla.meaning: Layla means “night” — a name of dark beauty and depth.

yasmin.meaning: Yasmin means “jasmine flower” — delicate fragrance and beauty.

asma.meaning: Asma means “lofty, eminent, precious” — noble and distinguished.

zahra.meaning: Zahra means “radiant, blooming” — bright and flowering.

sumayya.meaning: Sumayya, the first martyr of Islam, is honoured for her unwavering faith.

ruqayya.meaning: Ruqayya means “ascent, rise, gentleness” — a daughter of the Prophet.

hafsa.meaning: Hafsa means “young lioness” — a wife of the Prophet and a keeper of the Qur’an.
